pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Individual dark regions show soft pixel gradients at the boundaries with varying spatial areas, predominantly larger on the mid-flank and smaller towards the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-point intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank, appearing as a thin negative-space contrast.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck boundary, characterized by short, dark vertical protrusions against the background pixels.
